## Symbols

| Symbol | Meaning | Long Text |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✓ | pass | check mark in a table cell |
| → | arrow | arrow symbol with longer surrounding text |
| … | ellipsis | ellipsis symbol with enough text to wrap in narrow output |
